fact: On 17 June 2026 a Uni-CV workshop under the Interreg MAC project AP-BYTE_2CAP trained participants to turn drone-borne hyperspectral remote-sensing imagery into farm information; the two-year project is at an early testing stage on Santiago and Sao Vicente, with farmers to be involved later.
title: Inteligência artificial e drones ao serviço da agricultura cabo-verdiana
publisher: Universidade de Cabo Verde (Escola de Ciências Agrárias e Ambientais)
